lines.text: A cold @soda_can sweats on a picnic table.
Heat shimmers off the grass. The park is bright and still.
A hand grabs the @soda_can, leaving a clean print in the water beads.
The tab cracks open. Fizz sprays into the sunlight.
A thirsty walker tilts her head back and drinks deep.
Her shoulders drop. She smiles, eyes closed.
The @soda_can lands back on the table, still dripping.

writes.note: I drafted a short, visual 15 s scene from your line: one park, one cold drink, no dialogue.

reply.rationale: Expanded the one-line brief into a single-location scene of seven short action beats (about 14 s by the length rule), keeping @soda_can as the product hero.
